text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I conquered the Shinzan Kinen, 
intoxicating the crowd. Following the 
"Matsukuni Route," the next stop would be 
the NHK Mile Cup. However—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The tipsy patrons are clamoring for the 
Classic Triple Crown! To ignore this 
fervor goes against my very aesthetic!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is the royal 
road! Yet, the path we forge is one of 
great deeds and supremacy! Whoever heard 
of a hero slaying a hellhound just to 
avoid a dragon?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then before the NHK Mile Cup, it's the 
Satsuki Sho! Who do you think I am? Tanino 
Gimlet—the breaker of common sense!
